These presentations explore the connection between numerical theory,
sampling methods, and practical computation.

## MCQMC 2026

Edinburgh, June 8–12, 2026.

- [Where Quasi-Monte Carlo Theory and Practice Meet](https://fjhickernell.github.io/MCQMC26/slides/Plenary_MCQMC2026.html) — plenary talk
- [Good Lattice and Kronecker Sequences for Arbitrary Sample Sizes](https://fjhickernell.github.io/MCQMC26/slides/SpecialSession_MCQMC2026.html) — special session talk
- [Conference materials](https://fjhickernell.github.io/MCQMC26/)

## SIAM UQ 2026

[Low Discrepancy Drop-In Replacements for IID](https://fjhickernell.github.io/SIAMUQ26/)
discusses low-discrepancy sequences for computations with flexible sample sizes.
